name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Agency Operations & Commercial Deals | Deal Scoping, Client Agreements & Process Playbooks
summary: Agency and SaaS operator with 15+ years on the commercial side of client relationships: scoping and closing agreements, negotiating live with owners and executives, and building the processes and templates that keep delivery aligned with what was sold. Closed and scoped deals from ~$10K to $45K across agency and SaaS roles, built compliance systems from scratch in a licensed, regulated business, and led a team of 20 (later 8). Knows when a question needs an expert and escalates early.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Scope and expand client retainers, defining deliverables and recommending complementary services aligned with each client's objectives.
Build reusable templates and messaging frameworks, and document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable so engagements stay auditable.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder agency accounts across paid, inbound, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments and advising clients on budget allocation.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Sold and onboarded 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client agency deals averaging ~$22K (~$130K+ total), reached finalist stage on a major banking prospect, and led the sales team.

bullets: Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery.
